findings.evidence: `geometricNormalSubgroupFreeCommHopfAlgProperty` has an `IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms` instance from `P` in `Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/Radical/Basic.lean`, while each affected declaration also receives `hQ : Q = geometricNormalSubgroupFreeCommHopfAlgProperty k P`; therefore requiring closure of both equal properties unnecessarily restricts this generic API.
findings.fix: Require only `[P.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms]` and locally derive the `Q` instance by rewriting along `hQ` (or symmetrically retain only the `Q` assumption and derive the transported scheme-property instance).
findings.issue: The `[P.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms] [Q.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms]` assumptions are redundant in the restricted equivalence and both computation-interface helpers (lines 128, 143, 165): `hQ` identifies `Q` with the generic property, whose closure follows from closure of `P`.

summary: The generic restricted-equivalence API requires two isomorphism-closure hypotheses even though the equality of properties makes one derivable from the other.
